vector_memory.semantic_summary: CircleHelper is a specialized rendering utility responsible for managing the WebGL geometry (vertices and indices) required to draw a circle shape within the scene editor. It encapsulates the low-level buffer creation and manipulation, allowing higher-level systems to request rendering without geometry calculation overhead. Its primary methods, draw and destroy, handle the rendering pipeline execution and resource cleanup, respectively, relying on the WebGL2RenderingContext.
